summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals, a Canadian clinical-stage biotech, reporting a press release about its upcoming presentations at the Digestive Disease Week annual meeting. The press release details four abstracts on its EP-104GI trial for eosinophilic esophagitis and an investor event. There are no special-situation M&A, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change elements. This is a routine business development communication, equivalent to a US press release on conference participation.
